The current flow for adding or updating the PVID for a VF uses
i40e_vsi_add_vlan and i40e_vsi_kill_vlan which each take
the hash lock. In addition the two functions also must take special care
that they do not perform VLAN mode changes as this will make the code in
i40e_ndo_set_vf_port_vlan behave incorrectly.
Fix these issues by using the new helper functions i40e_add_vlan_all_mac
and i40e_rm_vlan_all_mac which expect the hash lock to already be taken.
Additionally these functions do not perform any state updates in regards
to VLAN mode
column2: so they are safe to use in the PVID update flow.

column1: It should be noted that we don't need the VLAN mode update code here
because there are only a few flows here.
(a) we're adding a new PVID
In this case
column2: if we already had VLAN filters the VSI is knocked

column1: offline so we don't need to worry about pre-existing VLAN filters
(b) we're replacing an existing PVID
In this case
column2: we can't have any VLAN filters except those with the old

column1: PVID which we already take care of manually.
(c) we're removing an existing PVID
Similarly to above
column2: we can't have any existing VLAN filters except

column1: those with the old PVID which we already take care of correctly.
Because of this
column2: we do not need (or even want) the special accounting

column1: done in i40e_vsi_add_vlan
column2: so use of the helpers is a saner alternative.

column1: It also opens the door for a future patch which will refactor the flow
of i40e_vsi_add_vlan now that it is not needed in this function.
